# Bundled community plugin artifacts

This directory contains reviewed, fixed-version build inputs for the Insight Desktop bundled Profile. It is not a plugin registry, runtime manager, source checkout, or independent update channel. The Shell installs these archives through the locked Core Runtime DSH CLI when generating the first-run Profile.

Archive hashes prove that builds consume the reviewed bytes. They do not restrict Host permissions. Each Host plugin runs inside the Harness Node.js process and can use its injected services and normal Node.js capabilities. Browser modules continue to use Harness client services and local Host routes; they do not receive Insight account tokens, cookies, or unrestricted Electron IPC from this integration.

The pinned Memory Evolve package has no npm `files` allowlist, so its normal archive includes source, tests, TypeScript configuration and upstream developer-machine paths. The Shell archive is therefore packed from a fixed staging allowlist containing the upstream `package.json`, license and readmes plus `cordis.patch.yml`, built `lib`, packaged skills, `vendor/mermaid.min.js` and `scripts/sync-worker.mjs`. These files remain byte-for-byte identical to the reviewed checkout; only non-runtime files are excluded. The other packages retain the files selected by their upstream package manifests. Archive review rejects `.git`, `node_modules`, `.DS_Store`, developer checkout paths, missing built entries, or a manifest that differs from the descriptor.

## Capability review

### dsh-memory-evolve

- Host services: requires `tools`, `systemPrompt`, `agents`, `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionTitle`, `sessionPersistence`, `settings`, and `llm`; it also exposes local web routes and registers memory, todo, skill, and optional orchestration tools.
- Files: account-scoped memory, configuration, cache, todo, advisor, canvas, and synchronization state resolve below `DSH_HOME`. The upstream default `~/.agents/skills` directory and legacy skill-manager state below `~/.dsh/plugins` are device-scoped. The shared skill directory is an accepted product exception; business records remain account-scoped.
- Network and processes: the package contains optional Git synchronization, update checks, URL attachment retrieval, local file search, external CLI scheduling, channel delivery, and OS reveal/open commands. Most broad modules are disabled by default; `channelSendEnabled` is enabled but has no destination without a separately installed channel provider.
- Browser rendering: the client calls only its local `/memory-evolve` routes. Optional Mermaid rendering inserts SVG generated by the bundled engine in strict mode; the UI settings module controlling that renderer is disabled by default.
- Startup: its `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the Host plugin into the Profile. Failure must be caught by disposable-Profile Host startup verification before the archive is admitted to the combined Profile.

### @changfenhuang/dsh-genui

- Host services: injects `systemPrompt`; it optionally registers tools, a bundled skill provider, invariants, and a local route serving only fixed JavaScript assets from its own package directory.
- Files, network, and processes: Host file reads are limited to the packaged skill and built visualization assets. No outbound network client or child-process execution is present in the reviewed source.
- Browser rendering: injects Harness slots and sessions. Declarative model output passes size/type guards. Mermaid SVG uses strict mode plus a second SVG safety check before the sole `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` path; ECharts HTML tooltips are disabled in favor of rich text.
- Startup: the plugin adds system-prompt guidance and registers its render/validation capabilities. A missing asset returns a controlled 404 and the client falls back instead of reading arbitrary paths.

### dsh-prompt-enhance

- Host services: requires `llm` and `webServer`; it optionally integrates settings, sessions, default model routing, and slash commands.
- Files, network, and processes: no direct filesystem access, outbound network client, or child-process execution is present. Enhancement calls use the configured Harness LLM provider through a loopback-only Host route with origin, concurrency, rate, input-size, and timeout controls.
- Browser rendering: injects composer slots, settings scope, and locale; it posts the draft to the local enhancement route and renders text in React components without raw HTML insertion.
- Startup: the feature is enabled by default and registers its route and composer action. Missing required `llm` or `webServer` services must fail disposable-Profile Host startup.

## Reproduction

All source builds and tests were run against the Shell's locked Core Runtime Node 24.9.0. Replace angle-bracket paths with disposable local paths; never persist them in an archive or descriptor.

Memory Evolve:

```bash
git checkout v26082401
git rev-parse HEAD
DSH_SOURCE=<shell-root> npm run build
DSH_HOME=<temporary-dsh-home> <locked-node> --test tests/*.test.js
mkdir -p <staging>/scripts
cp package.json LICENSE README.md README.en.md README-详细说明.md cordis.patch.yml <staging>/
cp -R lib skills vendor <staging>/
cp scripts/sync-worker.mjs <staging>/scripts/
cd <staging>
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination <shell-root>/vendor/plugins
```

The pinned upstream `npm test` quotes the glob and passes `tests/*.test.js` literally to Node, so the expanded command above is required. The staging allowlist prevents build-only files and upstream checkout paths from becoming Shell inputs without modifying plugin runtime code. Result: 776 tests passed.

GenUI:

```bash
git checkout v0.9.8
git rev-parse HEAD
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --reporter=append-only
pnpm run check
pnpm pack --pack-destination <shell-root>/vendor/plugins
```

Result: 453 tests passed, 104 upstream-declared tests skipped, and all build targets completed.

Prompt Enhance:

```bash
git checkout v0.1.9
git rev-parse HEAD
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm pack --pack-destination <shell-root>/vendor/plugins
```

Result: 132 tests passed; typecheck and build completed.

After packing, verify the package manifest and required entries with `tar`, compare the measured digest with `bundled-community-plugins.json`, and run `git diff --check`. Runtime admission remains a separate step: each package must install and boot by itself in a disposable Profile before `prepare-bundled-profile.mjs` combines them.
